fusions.name: Between the Lames
fusions.desc: A thin cut of air that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scale Storm
fusions.desc: A whirl of cutting air round you that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and ignores their armour.

fusions.name: Mantle in Motion
fusions.desc: Raises a shell of turning air that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, raising your armour by 8% while it holds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cuirass of Packed Air
fusions.desc: Conjures a cuirass of packed air: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, you move 5% faster, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
